author: Andrew Newland
title: EVSC kicks off graduation ceremonies - NewsBreak
text:
By Andrew Newland ,
1 hours ago EVANSVILLE, Ind. (WEHT) — It’s a big day for students in the river city. The Evansville Vanderburgh School Corporation kicked off its first wave of graduation ceremonies on Wednesday.
First on the docket was Reitz High School which kicked off at 5:30 p.m. at the Reitz Bowl. The ceremony was followed by Bosse High School at Enlow Field and Harrison High School at Romain Stadium which is happening right now.
As seniors braved the rain and walked the stage, EVSC officials told Eyewitness news they couldn’t be more excited for this graduating class.
